# hallpass_role (Resource)

A role on a server: the account the gateway logs in as and the limits of the access agents request. Give it a login key with `hallpass_login_key`, and decide who may use it with `hallpass_policy_rule`. Destroying it deletes the role: access ends and its login keys are revoked. For git remotes use `hallpass_git_access_profile`. Import with the role ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hallpass_role" "web1_inspect" {
  server_id        = hallpass_server.web1.id
  alias            = "inspect"
  description      = "Read logs and service status. No sudo."
  remote_user      = "ro"
  capabilities     = ["exec", "shell", "pty"]
  default_duration = "30m"
  max_duration     = "2h"
}

resource "hallpass_role" "web1_deploy" {
  server_id          = hallpass_server.web1.id
  alias              = "deploy"
  remote_user        = "deploy"
  capabilities       = ["exec", "file-transfer"]
  max_duration       = "4h"
  approvals_required = 2
  approval_channels  = ["web", "slack"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `alias` (String) Name agents request (`--role`), unique on the server.
- `remote_user` (String) Account on the server the gateway logs in as.
- `server_id` (String) Server ID (`srv_…`). Changing it forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `approval_channels` (Set of String) Where requests may be approved: `web`, `slack`, `telegram`.
- `approvals_required` (Number) Distinct approvers each request needs (1-5). Above 1, policy never approves automatically and any one denial ends the request.
- `capabilities` (Set of String) What agents may do: `shell` (interactive), `exec` (commands), `pty` (terminal) and `file-transfer` (scp and sftp).
- `default_duration` (String) Access duration when the agent does not ask for one. A duration such as `30m` or `4h`.
- `description` (String) Description, shown to operators.
- `display_name` (String) Display name (defaults to the alias).
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the role is enabled. Disabling ends active access within seconds and cancels pending requests; enabling lets policy decide again.
- `env_allow` (Set of String) Environment variables agents may pass (`LANG`, `LC_*`).
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels of the role, used by policy selectors.
- `max_concurrent` (Number) Concurrent connections across all agents.
- `max_concurrent_per_agent` (Number) Concurrent connections per agent.
- `max_duration` (String) Longest access an agent may request (policy may lower it). A duration such as `30m` or `4h`.
- `record_input` (Boolean) Also record what the agent types (may capture secrets).
- `recording_mode` (String) `mandatory` (no access without a working recording) or `best_effort`.
- `restriction_notes` (String) Notes on what the account may do (shown to approvers).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Role ID (`rol_…`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Role ID
terraform import hallpass_role.web1_inspect rol_01m5qh1t09e4jbmeys0q0bjz8j
```
